title: Acoustic Interference: A New Paradigm Weaponizing Acoustic Latent Semantic for Universal Jailbreak against Large Audio Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the difference in jailbreak Attack Success Rate (ASR) by calculating distributional shifts (Wasserstein Distance and Peak Shift) between successful and failed adversarial attacks using synthesized audio prompts representing different age groups (from child to elderly).

Analyzing the correlation between the perceived gender of the synthesized speaker (parameterized from absolute male to absolute female) and the model's susceptibility to safety alignment bypasses, measured via distributional shifts in attack success rates.
